data.name: Lubomir
data.gender_notes: Lubomir is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Slavic word 'lub' meaning 'love' and 'mir' meaning 'peace' or 'world'. This name signifies a person who brings light and love to the world. The name Lubomir carries the meaning “Light, My Love” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Lubomir usually hope their child will grow to embody light, my love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bringing light and love to the world
data.etymology: Lubomir belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, My Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lubomir total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: לובומיר
in_hebrew.meaning: משמעות פשוטה: יופי, חסד, אהבה, יפי תבל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: משמעות ארוכה: לובומיר הוא שם פולני שמקורו בשפה הסלאבית, שמשמעותו יופי, חסד, אהבה, יפי תבל. שם זה צורף לשימושי היהודים באירופה בתקופת האימפריה האוסטרו-הונגרית. שם זה נמצא גם במקורות יהודיים רבים וכן בספרות היהודית העברית.

in_greek.name: Λουπόμιρ
in_greek.meaning: σημαίνει: ομορφιά, ελεημοσύνη, αγάπη, ομορφιά του κόσμου
in_greek.long_meaning: πλήρης σημασία: ο Λουπόμιρ είναι πολωνικό όνομα που προέρχεται από την σλαβική γλώσσα, με τη σημασία της ομορφιάς, της ελεημοσύνης, της αγάπης και της ομορφιάς του κόσμου. Το όνομα αυτό χρησιμοποιήθηκε από τους Εβραίους στην Ευρώπη κατά την περίοδο της Αυστρο-Ουγγρικής Αυτοκρατορίας. Το όνομα αυτό συναντάται επίσης σε πολλά εβραϊκά πηγαία και στην εβραϊκή λογοτεχνία.

in_latin.name: Lubomir
in_latin.meaning: significat: pulchritudo, misericordia, amor, pulchritudo mundi
in_latin.long_meaning: significatio plena: Nomen Lubomir est Polonicum quod a lingua Slavia ortum est, significans pulchritudinem, misericordiam, amorem, et pulchritudinem mundi. Nomen hoc a Judaeis in Europa usum habuit tempore Imperii Austro-Hungarici. Nomen hoc in fontibus Judaeis multi et in litteratura Hebraica reperitur.

in_english.name: Lubomir
in_english.meaning: means: beauty, charity, love, beauty of the world
in_english.long_meaning: full meaning: Lubomir is a Polish name that originates from the Slavic language, meaning beauty, charity, love, and beauty of the world. This name was used by Jews in Europe during the Austro-Hungarian Empire period. This name is also found in many Jewish sources and in Hebrew literature. Lubomir is a name that reflects the values of kindness, compassion, and love, which are essential in the Christian tradition.
